description: Attributes GitHub Copilot token spend to git branches and repos by joining hook mapping events (branch.session.start) to copilot-chat dependency spans on the shared session id (hook session.id == dependencies copilot_chat.chat_session_id).

panels.description: Total tokens (input + output) attributed to the selected repo's branches over the selected time range.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let branchMap = traces
| where tostring(customDimensions["event"]) == "branch.session.start"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["session.id"]), branch = tostring(customDimensions["branch.id"]), repo = tostring(customDimensions["repo.name"])
| where isnotempty(branch)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, branch, repo) by session_key;
let calls = dependencies
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "copilot-chat"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["copilot_chat.chat_session_id"]), input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| where isnotempty(session_key) and isnotempty(model)
| join kind=inner branchMap on session_key
| where '${repo:raw}' == 'All' or repo == '${repo:raw}';
calls
| summarize ['Total Tokens'] = sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: Spotlight on the top 3 branches by spend: total tokens, input/output split, sessions, and the model that consumed the most tokens.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let branchMap = traces
| where tostring(customDimensions["event"]) == "branch.session.start"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["session.id"]), branch = tostring(customDimensions["branch.id"]), repo = tostring(customDimensions["repo.name"])
| where isnotempty(branch)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, branch, repo) by session_key;
let calls = dependencies
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "copilot-chat"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["copilot_chat.chat_session_id"]), input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| where isnotempty(session_key) and isnotempty(model)
| join kind=inner branchMap on session_key
| where '${repo:raw}' == 'All' or repo == '${repo:raw}';
let sel = calls | where branch == '${topbranch:raw}';
let topModel = sel | summarize s = sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) by model | top 1 by s | project Model = model, k = 1;
sel
| summarize Tokens = sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens), Input = sum(input_tokens), Output = sum(output_tokens), Sessions = dcount(session_key)
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter topModel on k
| project Tokens, Input, Output, Sessions, Model
